title: O.A./1187/2013 — SUNIL v. UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
text:
Central Administrative Tribunal
Principal Bench, New Delhi
OA No.1187/2013
This the 1st day of September, 2015
Hon’ble Shri Sudhir Kumar, Member (A)
Hon’ble Shri Raj Vir Sharma, Member(J)
Sunil S/o Shri Krishan Kumar,
R/o Fashion Camp, Rori Bazar,
Post Office Sirsa, District Sirsa,
Haryana-125055. ...Applicant.
(By Advocate: None)
Versus
Union Public Service Commission,
Through its Chairman
Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road,
New Delhi-110069. ...Respondent.
(By Advocate: Shri Rajender Nischal)
Order (oral)
Per Sudhir Kumar, Member (A)
Case called twice. None appears for the applicant. It is seen that
there was no representation on behalf of the applicant on 31.08.2015
also, even on the revised call. It is also seen that the rejoinder had been
filed as long back as on 07.07.2014, and for more than one year
thereafter, the applicant has failed to advance his arguments in the case.
Therefore, it appears that the applicant has lost interest in pursuing his
case, and the O.A. is dismissed in default, and for non-prosecution.
(Raj Vir Sharma) (Sudhir Kumar)

Member (J) Member (A)
/kdr/
